title: What happens on the second run: the thread through DBX-DEA

steps.title: File load
steps.note: COPY INTO skips files it already loaded; Auto Loader remembers them in its checkpoint

steps.title: Transformation
steps.note: INSERT INTO run twice doubles the rows; MERGE INTO or replaceWhere reach the same end state

steps.title: Job
steps.note: A repair run restarts the failed task from its first line, so the write must be idempotent

steps.title: Deployment
steps.note: A bundle keeps state: removed resources go, and manual workspace edits can be overwritten

steps.title: Access
steps.note: Unity Catalog grants are inherited downwards: revoke where the grant was made
